verdict.rationale: Sketch provides a dedicated developer portal (developer.sketch.com) with a documented JavaScript plugin API, in-browser API tester, official vanilla JS API stable across releases, plugin manager (skpm) for publishing/distributing plugins, and manual install support, plus CLI/URL-scheme integration options. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reviews confirming ease of building complex plugins and richer typings/type-definition documentation beyond API reference mentions.
